description: The site already has a site_token (a prior verify already succeeded, which also consumed its nonce) and retries /verify with that same, now-stale nonce -- verify never reissues a token for a site that already has one; use rotate-token (Bearer-authenticated) instead.

setup.note: the nonce below was this site's registration nonce, already consumed by the earlier successful verify that issued its token -- it is no longer a pending challenge

error.message: This site already has a token; verify cannot reissue one.
error.hint: Use POST /v1/sites/{id}/rotate-token with the existing Bearer token instead.
